title: 第5章 龙战二凤，月娥悲鸣，美奴功法齐丰收
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

萧月娥猝不及防，背后已中一掌。

胭脂狐吴媚！

原来胭脂狐吴媚、采花贼白小楼、毒医仇万离等五人，共称玄天五寇。此前吴媚见白小楼被萧月娥击杀，心中愤恨，但奈何她堪堪后天境界，哪是萧月娥半步先天敌手。

此刻尾随老丑，见他得逞在即，便偷袭而来。

两下夹击之下，萧月娥如何应对？再难幸免。

萧月娥看着那张丑脸近在眼前，浓烈的男子气息扑面而来。

她又惊又怒，尖叫着，本能地双手胡乱往他脸上抓。

先中迷药，再失佩剑，方寸早乱。

老丑轻易几下便是擒下了她。

将她制住，闻着那股特有的幽香，心中躁动几欲炸开。

他咬牙忍住。还不是时候。又看了眼吴媚：“来的正好，老夫还以为你食言了！“

吴媚娇笑道：“怎敢，只是奴家一直寻大爷你不到。“

老丑左手扣住萧月娥双腕，往上一提。

修长身子被压在院墙上。

道：“待我卸了她功力，你我三人......“

吴媚媚态百生道：“自是愿意万分。“

老丑万分得意。

暗忖运气不差，正愁无处消遣，现下两美在手。

她双脚乱踢。

可被人控住两腿，压迫之下无法发力，用力虽猛收效却微。

老丑见她挣扎得厉害。

伸手点了她下颌和双手穴道。再也无力气挣。

扯下布条，塞进她嘴里，堵住叫喊。

她双脚乱踢下，无意中踢翻墙角一个木匣。

匣子滚落，掉出一卷帛书。

老丑眼疾手快，弯腰捡起。展开一看。吴媚却落后一步。

正是那本《易容变化要诀》。揣入怀中。

老丑冷笑道：“怎地，你是来寻功法，还是来巡欢？”

吴媚知是机会已失，也不争夺，笑骂道：“大爷好生小气，我自是来寻大爷欢好，只怕大爷你得了新欢，却忘了奴家。”

老丑知她乃是逢场作戏，也不点破：“如此甚好，来，.......“

萧月娥从未想过自己会有这一天。

被一个又老又丑的人压在.......衣衫凌乱，双手被扣，嘴被堵住。

她拼命摇头挣扎。

老丑低头看她，喉结动了动，伸手便去解她的衣襟。

萧月娥趁机回头就要咬他，老丑岂能让她得逞，“啪“地一声，反手一个耳光将她打翻在地。

萧月娥吃疼，怒目而视。

“瞪什么？你还以为你还是那个高高在上的大师姐？“

吴媚在旁痴笑：“你这老鬼，好生粗鲁，对人家第一次也不知道温柔些。“

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Xiao Yue'e was caught off guard and was hit in the back.

Rouge Fox Wu Mei!

It turns out that five people, including the rouge fox Wu Mei, the flower picker Bai Xiaolou, and the poisonous doctor Qiu Wanli, are collectively known as the Xuantian Five Bandits.Previously, Wu Mei saw Bai Xiaolou being killed by Xiao Yue'e, and felt resentful in her heart. However, she was in the acquired realm, so she was not Xiao Yue'e's half-step innate rival.

At this moment, he was following Lao Chou and saw that he was about to succeed, so he made a sneak attack.

How did Xiao Yue'e respond to the two flanking attacks?No matter how hard it is to survive.

Xiao Yue'e looked at that ugly face close in front of her eyes, and a strong masculine aura hit her face.

She was frightened and angry, screaming, and instinctively clawed at his face with her hands.

First he was drugged, and then he lost his sword, causing chaos early on.

Lao Chou easily captured her in a few strokes.

He restrained her and smelled the unique fragrance, his heart was so restless that he almost wanted to explode.

He gritted his teeth and held back.It's not the time yet.He glanced at Wu Mei again: "You came just in time, I thought you broke your promise!"

Wu Meijiao smiled and said: "How dare you, it's just that the slave family has been looking for you, but you can't find me."

Lao Chou grabbed Xiao Yuee's wrists with his left hand and lifted them up.

The slender body was pressed against the courtyard wall.

Said: "When I remove her power, the three of you and me..."

Wu Mei said in a charming manner: "I am very willing."

The old man was very proud.

I secretly think that my luck is not bad, and I am worried that I have nowhere to amuse myself. Now I have two beauties in my hands.

She kicked her feet wildly.

But his legs were controlled by someone, and he was unable to exert force under the pressure. Although he exerted force, the effect was little.

The old man saw her struggling fiercely.

He reached out and tapped the acupuncture points on her jaw and hands.No more energy to earn.

He pulled off the strip of cloth and stuffed it into her mouth to muffle her screams.

She kicked her feet down and accidentally knocked over a wooden box in the corner.

The box rolled down and a silk book fell out.

Old Chou, with quick eyes and quick hands, bent down to pick it up.Expand it and take a look.Wu Mei was one step behind.

It was the book "Keys to Disguise Change".Put it in your arms.

The old man sneered and said, "What the hell, are you here to look for exercises, or are you here to have fun?"

Wu Meiqi knew that the opportunity was lost, so she did not fight for it. She laughed and scolded: "Uncle, I am so stingy. I came here to have fun with you. I am afraid that you will find a new love and forget about the slave family."

The old ugly man knew that she was just making fun of herself, so he didn't point it out: "That's very good, come on..."

Xiao Yuee never thought that this day would come to her.

Being pinned down by an old and ugly man... his clothes were messy, his hands were tied, and his mouth was blocked.

She shook her head and struggled.

The old Chou looked down at her, his Adam's apple moved, and reached out to untie her clothes.

Xiao Yue'e took the opportunity to turn around and bite him. How could Lao Chou let her succeed? With a "pop", he slapped her to the ground with his backhand.

Xiao Yue'e felt pain and glared angrily.

"What are you staring at? Do you still think you are still the superior senior sister?"

Wu Mei smiled foolishly at the side: "You old ghost, you are so rude, you don't know how to be gentle to others for the first time."
